2609.19291.title: Why Pretraining Fails to Share Cross-Lingual Knowledge
2609.19291.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in the processing and modeling of many languages. Yet, unlike human multilinguals, they exhibit surprisingly limited cross-lingual knowledge transfer. While this limitation is well documented, its origins during multilingual training remain unclear. We pretrain 360M- and 7B-parameter LLMs and show that poor cross-lingual knowledge generalization emerges during pretraining and persists under standard interventions. To isolate its cause, we employ a controlled bilingual pretraining setting using two copies of the same language, sharing identical text and token segmentation, but mapped to disjoint token spaces. We find that disjoint tokens alone are enough to induce knowledge compartmentalization, even between identical copies of the same language, establishing disjoint token spaces as a fundamental barrier to cross-lingual knowledge generalization. Guided by this understanding, we suggest mapping languages into a shared token space by simple word-wise translation and find it substantially improves cross-lingual knowledge generalization, recovering up to 12.6\% of native-language learning efficiency --- 14$\times$ the baseline.
2609.19291.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在許多語言的處理和建模方面取得了顯著進展。<lb/>然而，與人類多語者不同，它們表現出驚人地有限的跨語言知識轉移。<lb/>雖然這一限制已有充分的文獻記載，但在多語言訓練過程中其起源仍不清楚。<lb/>我們預訓練了360M和7B參數的LLMs，並顯示出在預訓練過程中出現的跨語言知識泛化不良，並在標準干預下持續存在。<lb/>為了隔離其原因，我們採用受控的雙語預訓練設置，使用兩個相同語言的副本，分享相同的文本和標記分割，但映射到不相交的標記空間。<lb/>我們發現，僅僅是不相交的標記就足以引起知識的隔離，即使是在相同語言的相同副本之間，確立了不相交的標記空間作為跨語言知識泛化的基本障礙。<lb/>在這一理解的指導下，我們建議通過簡單的逐詞翻譯將語言映射到共享的標記空間，並發現這大大改善了跨語言知識的泛化，恢復了高達12.6%的母語學習效率——是基線的14倍。
